headlines.title: Dutch chip firm Besi's shares jump as Applied Materials moves to double stake
headlines.summary: Shares in Dutch chip equipment maker Besi jumped on Tuesday after US rival Applied Materials announced plans to lift its holding to roughly 20% from 9%, tightening ties built around technology used to make AI hardware.

headlines.title: What Does Applied Materials (AMAT) Owning About 20% Mean For Its AI Push?
headlines.summary: Applied Materials (NasdaqGS:AMAT) is increasing its investment in BE Semiconductor Industries to around a 20% ownership stake. The expanded holding deepens their partnership around hybrid bonding and next generation chip interconnect technologies used in AI hardware. Management signals a long term commitment to BE Semiconductor Industries as chipmakers scale advanced packaging for AI and high performance computing.

headlines.title: BE Semiconductor stock surges as Applied Materials plans to raise stake to 20%
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- BE Semiconductor Industries shares jumped more than 8% Tuesday after Applied Materials announced plans to increase its stake in the Dutch semiconductor equipment maker to approximately 20% from 9%. The move deepens a partnership between the two companies focused on advanced chip-packaging technologies used in AI applications.

description: Applied Materials, Inc. provides materials engineering solutions, equipment, services, and software to the semiconductor and related industries in the United States, China, Korea, Taiwan, Japan, Southeast Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Semiconductor Systems and Applied Global Services (AGS) segments. The Semiconductor Systems segment includes semiconductor capital equipment to enable materials engineering steps, including etch, rapid thermal processing, deposition, chemical mechanical planarization, metrology and inspection, wafer packaging, and ion implantation. The AGS segment offers integrated solutions to optimize equipment and fab performance and productivity comprising spares, upgrades, services, and 200 millimeter and other equipment and factory automation software for semiconductor and other products. It serves manufacturers of semiconductor wafers and chips, and other electronic devices. Applied Materials, Inc. was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.
